problem: Restaurant chains in Nigeria are hard to scale because of rent, kitchen build-out and fragmented supply.
business_model: owned restaurant brands using an asset light central kitchen and rented commercial kitchens, with delivery-only and dine-in formats
product_category: restaurant chain and cloud kitchen operator

founders.background_notes: YC page says he built products at Moniepoint.
